description: This file defines the AssignLeaveController class, which extends an abstract controller and handles preparing a Vue component for assigning leave within the OrangeHRM system. It is part of the leave plugin and is responsible for setting up the leave assignment UI component before rendering.

classes.name: AssignLeaveController
classes.description: Controller responsible for initializing the leave assignment Vue component before rendering the view.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave-assign Vue component and sets it up for rendering.
